mapper.sql: WITH warehouse_skus AS ( SELECT UPPER(TRIM(d.sku)) sku, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(w.name,''),CAST(d.wid AS CHAR)) ORDER BY w.name SEPARATOR '、') warehouseNames, MAX(d.sync_time) warehouseSyncTime FROM amz_warehouse_inventory_detail d LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.wid=d.wid WHERE d.sku IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(d.sku)!='' GROUP BY UPPER(TRIM(d.sku)) ), sales AS ( SELECT sid,msku,MAX(sales_30d) sales30d, MAX(updated_at) salesSyncTime FROM amz_restock_summary WHERE node_type IN (2,3) AND TRIM(msku)!='' GROUP BY sid,msku ), channel_keys AS ( SELECT sid,seller_sku FROM amz_product_listing WHERE seller_sku!='' UNION SELECT sid,seller_sku FROM amz_product_performance_inventory WHERE seller_sku!='' ), shops AS ( SELECT sid,MAX(NULLIF(store_name,'')) storeName, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(currency,''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(currency,'')) END currency FROM shop_list WHERE platform_code='10001' GROUP BY sid ), channels AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ws.sku,k.sid,k.seller_sku sellerSku, COALESCE(sh.storeName,CONCAT('SID ',k.sid)) storeName, l.local_name productName,l.small_image_url imageUrl,l.asin,l.marketplace,l.principal_name principalName, l.price salePrice,COALESCE(NULLIF(l.currency_code,''),sh.currency) currency, i.fba_stock fbaStock,i.fba_inbound fbaInbound,i.fba_stock+i.fba_inbound fbaTotalInventory, s.sales30d,i.sync_time inventorySyncTime,s.salesSyncTime,l.sync_time listingSyncTime FROM channel_keys k LEFT JOIN amz_product_listing l ON l.sid=k.sid AND l.seller_sku=k.seller_sku LEFT JOIN amz_product_performance_inventory i ON i.sid=k.sid AND i.seller_sku=k.seller_sku LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.sid=k.sid AND s.msku=k.seller_sku LEFT JOIN shops sh ON sh.sid=k.sid INNER JOIN warehouse_skus ws ON ws.sku=COALESCE(NULLIF(l.local_sku,''),NULLIF(i.local_sku,'')) k.sid=#{q.sid} )

SELECT ws.sku,ws.warehouseNames,ws.warehouseSyncTime, MAX(c.productName) productName,MAX(c.imageUrl) imageUrl, COUNT(c.sellerSku) listingCount,COUNT(DISTINCT c.sid) storeCount, COUNT(c.fbaTotalInventory) inventoryMatchedCount,COUNT(c.sales30d) salesMatchedCount, SUM(c.fbaStock) fbaStock,SUM(c.fbaInbound) fbaInbound, SUM(c.fbaTotalInventory) fbaTotalInventory,SUM(c.sales30d) sales30d, MIN(c.inventorySyncTime) inventorySyncTime,MIN(c.salesSyncTime) salesSyncTime FROM warehouse_skus ws LEFT JOIN channels c ON c.sku=ws.sku c.sid=#{q.sid} GROUP BY ws.sku,ws.warehouseNames,ws.warehouseSyncTime

ORDER BY
sku fbaStock IS NULL,fbaStock fbaInbound IS NULL,fbaInbound sales30d IS NULL,sales30d fbaTotalInventory IS NULL,fbaTotalInventory
ASCDESC,sku
